comparisonLimits: The wrapper preserves the retained walker's sequential fresh-resource schedule and cursor order, but records a page count instead of every page timing object and omits lastFetched/lastDurable marker assignments.
Unlike the historical standalone walker timing, this timer begins before navigation and adds persona auth, React mounting, SDK-forced-offline first history, and first-page search/render.
The ordinary client configuration and authored storage adapter are unchanged. The service worker is the corrected shell-only harness worker.
The EPYC database page cache was warm after candidate diagnostics; historical runs used other machine/profile conditions. No matched historical 33-second ratio is claimed.
